faq.question: What does Selim mean?
faq.answer: Selim is associated with the Arabic form سَلِيم, whose core sense is selim; sound, free from defect (turkish form).

faq.question: Is Selim an Arabic name?

faq.question: Is Selim an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Selim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.answer: Selim should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. The root س ل م is Quranic, but Salīm is not itself a Quranic personal name.
